Extension
public class ClientHelloPreSharedKeyExtension extends PreSharedKeyExtension
TLS Pre-Shared Key Extension, ClientHello variant. see https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8446#section-4.2.11

    • calculateBinder

      public void calculateBinder(byte[] clientHello, int pskExtensionStartPosition, byte[] transcriptPrefix, BinderCalculator calculator)
      Computes the binder for the given client hello.
      Parameters:
      clientHello - the serialized client hello
      pskExtensionStartPosition - the position of this extension in the serialized client hello
      transcriptPrefix - the transcript that precedes the client hello; empty for a first client hello, see https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8446#section-4.2.11.2
      calculator - computes the binder value
